downloads.title: The Question Method Tip Sheet
downloads.desc: Quick tips, the four question types with where to look for each, and a research checklist in three parts: before you start, every cycle (rinse and repeat), and checking out.
downloads.use: Keep it beside you for every assignment. Run the checklist against your Research Log and research map before you call a project done.

downloads.title: Research Log Template (spreadsheet)
downloads.desc: A blank log, one row per research cycle, with the book's seven fields as columns: Research Question, Question Type (a dropdown), Method, Findings, Source Consulted, Next Question, Notes.
downloads.use: Open it before your first exercise, write your macro question above the table, and add a row for every cycle you run.

downloads.title: Worked Example: Research Map, Research Log, and Annotated Outline
downloads.desc: One Arizona notice-of-claim problem run through all three tools, so you can see how a question moves from the map to the log to the outline.
downloads.use: Read it first, then try the Notice of Claim sandbox in Chapter 3 and build your own.

downloads.title: Key Takeaways and Common Pitfalls, by Chapter
downloads.desc: Every chapter's Key Takeaways and Common Pitfalls on one set of pages. Rebuilt automatically from the chapter text whenever the site is built.
downloads.use: Review before an exam or a project kickoff; check that you can restate each chapter in your own words.

downloads.title: Scholarship Research Checklist
downloads.desc: The ten-step method from Chapter 17 for seminar papers, notes, and comments.
downloads.use: Run it when the paper is assigned, and again before submission.

downloads.title: The whole book (Word)
downloads.desc: Every chapter and appendix in one document, with a table of contents, regenerated on every build. Interactives appear as one-line pointers to the online edition; draft flags are left out.
downloads.use: Read offline, print, or run a spell-check and a global find-and-replace across the whole text.
